newsitem.title: USA: National Patent reports improved operations.
newsitem.headline: National Patent reports improved operations.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp said Wednesday that its operations during the first quarter of the year had improved over the same period last year even though the company registered a loss.
National Patent, which provides support services to the private and public sector, reported a share loss of $0.10 for the period against a profit of $0.01 a year ago.
"The primary reason for the net loss was due to writing down certain trading marketable securities to current market value," it said.

Excluding the adjustments, pretax income reached $830,000 for the first quarter from a loss of $391,000 for the same period a year ago, it said. Sales totaled $54.8 million against $48.2 million, it added.
The company said operating income for the period was a profit of $0.08 a share against a loss $0.04 a year ago.
"The increase in sales and profits from operating units for the first quarter of 1996 is additional evidence that the company is proceeding on the right course," it said.
